exceptions.reason: The one-shot Synapse permissions task must change ownership of the existing data volume before the server starts as UID 991.
mitigations: The task runs once and has no network attachment.
The long-running Synapse server runs as UID 991 with a read-only root filesystem and all capabilities dropped.

exceptions.reason: The one-shot permissions task needs CHOWN, DAC_OVERRIDE, and FOWNER to repair ownership and modes in the Synapse data volume.
mitigations: All capabilities are dropped before adding only the three permissions needed by the one-shot task.
The task enables no-new-privileges and mounts only the Synapse data volume.
